sourceMaterials.text:
Voxel sandbox game: one prompt, three games | CmdBench  Skip to content     >_ CmdBenchby CmdBrief        
   Menu   
 
   
    Voxel sandbox game
 One prompt, three games. Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol on high effort.
 Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex CLI each built a first-person voxel sandbox game from the same prompt and no picture: a generated block world to walk through, mine and build in. One run each on high effort, with no human edits.
  This is not a CmdBench benchmark run: no checks, scores or verdicts.
     The three games
 One run per model. Each game is served exactly as the agent wrote it, with no human edits, and opens full screen in this tab.
 
        Claude Fable 5.2
 Tessel Isle: an island of 192 × 192 blocks, drawn with Three.js and its own shaders, with nine blocks to build with.
  Built byClaude Fable 5.2·, high effort
AgentClaude Code 2.1.322
 Time37 min 49 s
 Output tokens226,931
 Cost estimate$13.81
 Files writtenindex.html, style.css, js/config.js, js/main.js, js/mesher.js, js/noise.js, js/shaders.js, js/textures.js, js/world.js
  Play the game by Claude Fable 5.2
 Click the game to look around; each game shows its own controls. Made for a mouse and keyboard. Opens full screen in this tab.
 
  The same scripted minute of play, in four frames
     0:02Before the first click  
   0:19Mining

   0:59The sky, later  
  
  
      Claude Opus 5.5
 Voxel Valley: 160 × 160 blocks, drawn with Three.js and its own shaders, with ten blocks to build with.
  Built byClaude Opus 5.5·, high effort
AgentClaude Code 2.1.322

 Output tokens115,281
 Cost estimate$3.61
 Files writtenindex.html, style.css, blocks.js, main.js, mesher.js, noise.js, shaders.js, world.js
  Play the game by Claude Opus 5.5

  The same scripted minute of play, in four frames
     0:02Before the first click  
   0:19Mining

   0:59The sky, later  
  
  
      GPT-6.1 Sol
 Wildfield: 96 × 96 blocks, drawn with Three.js in one script, with five blocks to build with.
  Built byGPT-6.1 Sol·, high effort
AgentCodex CLI 0.167.1
 Time13 min 5 s
 Output tokens32,105
 Cost estimate$0.37
 Files writtenindex.html, style.css, game.js
  Play the game by GPT-6.1 Sol
 Click the game to look around; each game shows its own controls. Made for a mouse and keyboard. Opens full screen in this tab.
 
  The same scripted minute of play, in four frames
     0:02Before the first click  
   0:19Mining  
   0:33Building  
   0:59The sky, later  
  
  
  In the same scripted minute of play, all three games took the mouse and keys: each one locks the mouse to look around, walks, jumps, mines the block its highlight marks, picks a block by number key and by mouse wheel, places blocks, and changes its sky as the minute passes.
One difference between the runs: Codex CLI can't be limited to file tools, so the GPT-6.1 Sol run could also run commands in a sandbox (its own folder, no network, no browser). Its log shows it ran none; it only wrote files.
Costs are estimates at API list prices. For Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5 they are Claude Code's own. Codex CLI reports no cost, so GPT-6.1 Sol's is computed from the run's own token counts at OpenAI's list prices of 09.11.2026.
 One run per model: exploratory, not a ranking.

  Build a first-person voxel sandbox game that runs in a desktop browser: a world made of blocks that the player walks through, mines and builds in.

 AgentsClaude Code 2.1.322 (Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Opus 5.5); Codex CLI 0.167.1 (GPT-6.1 Sol)
 Efforthigh, one run per model
 ToolsClaude Code had file tools only (Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep): no browser, no shell, no web. Codex CLI can't be limited to file tools, so the GPT-6.1 Sol run could also run commands in a sandbox: its own folder only, no network, no browser. Its log shows it ran none; it only wrote files. No model saw its game running.
 Time limit60 minutes per run
